In accordance with the FAQs issued by the Stock Exchange on July 9, 2025, where an ESOP scheme is implemented through a trust involving secondary acquisition, or where the Company has already allotted equity shares to the Trust against outstanding ESOP grants, such grants do not result in dilution of the paid up equity share capital and are not required to be disclosed in the Shareholding Pattern (SHP). Accordingly, disclosure of diluted shareholding on account of outstanding ESOP grants is not applicable for the present submission.

2. The paid-up share capital of the company has been revised from 27,94,97,838 fully paid-up equity shares to 27,48,03,838 fully paid-up equity shares on account of buyback through tender offer route and extinguishment of 46,94,000 fully paid-up equity shares in July 2026. Accordingly, the paid-up share capital for the current quarter stands revised as compared to the previous quarter.
